description: This header file defines inline functions for managing and checking the state of the filesystem monitor within a Git repository, including functions to verify if the filesystem monitor has been refreshed, to mark cache entries as valid or invalid, and to handle submodule considerations.

methods.name: int is_fsmonitor_refreshed(const struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Checks if the filesystem monitor has been initialized at least once, based on the repository's settings and state.

methods.name: void mark_fsmonitor_valid(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Marks a cache entry as valid for the filesystem monitor, unless it is a submodule or the monitor is disabled.

methods.name: void mark_fsmonitor_invalid(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Invalidates a cache entry and associated untracked cache information, indicating that the file's state needs refreshing.

ctags.name: mark_fsmonitor_invalid
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void mark_fsmonitor_invalid(struct index_state *istate, struct cache_entry *ce)$/

ctags.name: mark_fsmonitor_valid
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void mark_fsmonitor_valid(struct index_state *istate, struct cache_entry *ce)$/
